database_search_audit.method: Equation-level inspection of publisher, ADS scan, arXiv HTML, source, or PDF for every retained close family
database_search_audit.result: Equation-level similarities and differences are recorded below; corpus absence remains non-authoritative.

retained_primary_sources.title: Towards a general field equation for galaxies and galaxy clusters
retained_primary_sources.relevance: Defines beta=-g/(r g'), multiplies the GRAS/AQUAL response by beta, integrates inward from an outer boundary, and makes the interior depend on the complete baryonic mass distribution.

retained_primary_sources.title: Does the missing mass problem signal the breakdown of Newtonian gravity?
retained_primary_sources.relevance: Provides the Lagrangian-derived field-dependent interpolating function and acceleration scale underlying the MOND/AQUAL motif.

retained_primary_sources.title: Dynamics of galaxies and clusters in refracted gravity
retained_primary_sources.relevance: Uses a density-dependent gravitational permittivity in a modified Poisson equation and applies it to cluster X-ray temperature profiles.

retained_primary_sources.title: Nonlocal Gravity: Modified Poisson's Equation
retained_primary_sources.relevance: Introduces a constitutive nonlocal kernel in the Newtonian field equation and explicitly treats the inverse problem for the kernel.

retained_primary_sources.title: Unifying all mass discrepancies with one effective gravity law?
retained_primary_sources.relevance: Adds gravitational-potential depth to acceleration dependence so one phenomenology can differ between galaxies and clusters.

retained_primary_sources.title: Acceleration in Modified Gravity (MOG) and the Mass-Discrepancy Baryonic Relation
retained_primary_sources.relevance: Provides a covariant scalar-vector-tensor parent whose weak-field acceleration depends on strength and range parameters and has been applied to galaxies and clusters.

retained_primary_sources.title: Emergent Gravity and the Dark Universe
retained_primary_sources.relevance: Relates an additional force to baryonic mass and a horizon acceleration scale through a nonlocal or memory-like response motif.

retained_primary_sources.title: The Structure of Cold Dark Matter Halos
retained_primary_sources.relevance: Conventional collisionless-halo comparator; adds a mass component rather than a baryon-conditioned acceleration operator.

retained_primary_sources.title: The Inner Structure of LambdaCDM Halos III: Universality and Asymptotic Slopes
retained_primary_sources.relevance: Einasto-like conventional halo-shape comparator with flexible curvature in log radius.

retained_primary_sources.title: The universal galaxy cluster pressure profile from a representative sample of nearby systems and the Y_SZ-M_500 relation
retained_primary_sources.relevance: Flexible empirical pressure-shape comparator; predicts pressure phenomenology without being a gravity law.
